name: x-post
notes: Modelled on x.com as of 2026-09; not run against live X. /compose/post opens the composer as a modal dialog over the home timeline, whose inline composer carries the same data-testid, so the editor and the button are scoped to [role=dialog]. signedIn: the side nav's account switcher (SideNav_AccountSwitcher_Button), rendered only when logged in. Post text: the Draft.js contenteditable (data-testid tweetTextarea_0). submit: the modal's Post button (data-testid tweetButton; the inline one is tweetButtonInline). receipt: the 'Your post was sent.' toast (data-testid toast) and its View link to /<handle>/status/<id>.
